name: Kintsugi
author: Erin Carter
description: Gold-repaired pottery broken the way struck glaze really breaks: radial cracks spread and split outward from a few strike points, ringed by concentric hackle and laced with a fine craquelure - each crack type dialable on its own. Molten gold floods the breaks over one continuous palette-tinted ceramic glaze, and optional movable light sources travel the surface so the gold catches the light and flares as a light passes. A branching fracture web, never a uniform cell mosaic.

params.label: Strikes
params.effect: How many strike points the fracture radiates from; one gives a single dramatic spiderweb break, many overlap into a richly shattered surface.

params.label: Spread
params.effect: Scale and reach of the fracture; low keeps tight dense webs near each strike, high lets the cracks branch and travel across the whole vessel.

params.label: Radial cracks
params.effect: Strength of the radial spoke cracks that shoot out from each strike and split as they go - the main branching break lines.

params.label: Ring cracks
params.effect: Strength of the concentric hackle rings circling each strike point; raise for a classic spiderweb impact, drop for pure radial breaks.

params.label: Craquelure
params.effect: Strength of the fine all-over hairline craquelure that laces the glaze between the main breaks; adds delicate gold filigree texture.

params.label: Seam width
params.effect: Width of the gold repair seams in CSS pixels - a hairline lacquer line at the minimum, a generous molten channel of liquid gold at the maximum.

params.label: Shimmer
params.effect: Intensity and speed of the molten shimmer travelling the seams; 0 lets the gold rest as a steady gleam, 2 keeps every mend quietly boiling.

params.label: Light sources
params.effect: Number of moving light sources gliding over the vessel; the gold flares hot where a light passes. 0 leaves only the molten shimmer (the default look), higher adds travelling highlights.

params.label: Light speed
params.effect: How fast the light sources drift across the surface; 0 pins them as fixed highlights, high sweeps the gleam restlessly over the gold. No effect when Light sources is 0.
